BuildStream Cache Utilization

Remote-execution cache fill across both cache drives: ghost (bazel-remote + Buildbarn shard) and exo-0 (Buildbarn shard).

bst Cache Heat Map

live
Collected: Aug 12, 2026, 1:39 AM UTC

bazel-remote is nodeSelector-pinned to ghost; Buildbarn's 2-shard CAS/AC is scheduled across ghost and exo-0 via podAntiAffinity. Buildbarn's block-device-backed storage is preallocated on disk, so its cell values are a derived estimate of logical fill (allocator counters × known block size), not raw disk bytes.

Heatmap scale: Cache utilization (%) from 0% to 100%; gray cells are unavailable.
